evidence.quote: private readonly bookings = new Map<string, ClubBooking>();

responsibilities.description: Keeps club bookings in an in-memory store. It assigns a new id to each booking and looks bookings up by id.
responsibilities.name: Store and retrieve club bookings

responsibilities.description: Returns club bookings sorted by date and start time. It can also narrow the list to one day or one calendar month, which supports scheduling and monthly invoicing.
responsibilities.name: List club bookings chronologically, by day or by month

responsibilities.description: Holds the club's hourly rate in cents. The starting value comes from an environment setting, and the rate can be read or changed later.
responsibilities.name: Hold the club hourly rate
